title: MakerCoachInput
description: Input contract for lumei-human-ai-operational-maker-coach capturing a bounded operational friction or decision bottleneck.

work_problem.description: Concrete operational friction, handover delay, knowledge bottleneck, or decision difficulty.

intended_value.description: Targeted improvement (e.g. reduced rework, clearer handoff, faster retrieval) without unverified claims.

users_or_stakeholders.description: Specific frontline roles, engineers, or teammates involved in this workflow.

authorised_evidence.description: Authorized data sources, operational documents, or observable records available.

known_constraints.description: Safety boundaries, shift limits, system constraints, or regulatory limits.

decision_rights.description: What the user is legitimately authorized to modify or test, and what requires external sign-off.

prohibited_actions.description: Actions strictly forbidden during this experiment (e.g. no DCS setpoint change, no bypass of MOC).

consequence_level.description: High consequence halts maker coaching and routes to formal MOC/PSSR/PSM channels.
